title: Assessing Risks of Large Language Models in Mental Health Support: A Framework for Automated Clinical AI Red Teaming
reasoning: The paper includes a section on the Ethical Implications of AI Psychotherapy (Section 8.3), but this is a discussion of the societal and professional ethical risks of deployment rather than a component that evaluates or benchmarks the models' religious or moral stances.
